system.description:
Akin to Soulsight, this grim diagnostic power reveals a different aspect of the subject's condition: by looking at her subject, the Cappadocian may discern exactly which physical disease, if any, ails the individual, and may then cure it by lending the subject a measure of her own Fortitude. The power is limited by the Cappadocian's own knowledge of medicine — an unfamiliar disease cannot be identified.

System: The Storyteller resolves this challenge in secret to keep the result from the player. Win a Mental Challenge (retest with Medicine, or Herbalism if poison is suspected) to diagnose the ailment; the margin of victory indicates the precision of the diagnosis, while a failure leaves the disease unidentified and a botch gives a wholly inaccurate result. If the disease is correctly identified, the Cappadocian may then win a Static Physical Challenge (retest with Medicine) against a difficulty set by the Storyteller according to the severity of the illness to actually cure it; the victim does not instantly recover but takes a clear turn for the better. A botch on this second challenge instead worsens the illness, possibly fatally.
system.source: Clanbook: Cappadocian, Chapter Three: Observations and Conclusions
